description: Source code for the FreeType PFR font loader, including functions for parsing font headers, logical fonts, physical fonts, and extra items within PFR font files.

methods.name: pfr_extra_items_skip
methods.description: Skips over extra items in a font file stream.

methods.name: pfr_extra_items_parse
methods.description: Parses extra items in a font file stream, calling associated parser functions.

methods.name: pfr_header_load
methods.description: Loads the font header from a stream and adjusts size fields.

methods.name: pfr_header_check
methods.description: Validates the font header signature and size.

methods.name: pfr_log_font_count
methods.description: Counts the number of logical fonts in a section.

methods.name: pfr_log_font_load
methods.description: Loads a specific logical font's data from a stream.

methods.name: pfr_phy_font_done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a physical font.

methods.name: pfr_phy_font_load
methods.description: Loads a physical font's data from a stream, parsing font metrics, character descriptors, and auxiliary data.
